verdict.rationale: Bun installs from the npm registry (the largest, actively maintained JS package repository) and is designed as a drop-in npm-compatible replacement, supporting overrides/resolutions, lockfile migration from npm/yarn/pnpm, global installs, and `bunx` execution of registry packages. Community evidence corroborates real-world usage installing packages via Bun successfully, though some report compatibility edge cases with specific tools like Playwright/Crawlee. Missing for 10: independent registry-size/breadth verification and resolution of occasional install bugs reported by users.
